**Presentation:** poster; accepted for presentation.

**Institution / venue:** Labomar — Instituto de Ciências do Mar, Universidade Federal do Ceará (UFC).  
**Location:** Fortaleza, Brazil.  
**Dates:** 19–23 October 2026.  
**Support:** financial support awarded by the workshop organizers.

## Research topic

Probabilistic criteria for uniqueness and dynamic uniqueness of laws associated with infinite-memory shift systems. The work concerns chains with complete connections on standard Borel spaces and uses Hellinger-type bounds, absolute continuity, conditional probability kernels, disintegration, and ergodic arguments.
